title: Cocone-leg extension and morphism factorization
statement: Under the hypotheses of the component extension theorem, given compatible global model data c and i, there exist an extension b of the cocone leg and a factorization through i for every compatible map β.

proof.text: STATEMENT-DISPUTED: The universal cancellation conclusion is false. Take c to be the identity pointed triple over R and s the diagonal etale R-algebra R × R, pointed through its first coordinate. Let i be R → R_p → t.B and β the first projection followed by i. Both compatibility equations hold. Any arrow c → s is the diagonal by its R-algebra compatibility. The two maps s.B → K through the coordinate projections agree after this arrow, but differ on (1, 0). The claimed cancellation would give 1 = 0 in K. The private factorization_counterexample proves these facts, and factorization_statement_refuted refutes the full assertion with the explicitly constructed residuePointingCocone. No proof from affine descent can establish the unchanged false statement; this is a certified dispute, not a replacement proof or decomposition. Repair X-f1981: the false declaration and its docstring are now deleted entirely, retaining only the checked private certificates. Repair X-472ac additionally retires the existential caller component_extension_aux: it too is false by the finite-field product obstruction recorded in its node. Its caller component_extension_exists retains its unchanged statement as an unresolved named theorem. No replacement factorization theorem is introduced.
